title: Bavarian Potato Gratin
description: A rich and creamy German-inspired potato dish, perfect for a cold winter night. This hearty gratin is made with thinly sliced potatoes, onions, and cheese, all baked in a golden brown crust.
instructions: Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish and set aside.
Thinly slice the Yukon potatoes and layer them in the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle the sliced onions and grated Gruyère cheese between the layers of potatoes.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk to form a smooth paste.
Gradually add the heavy cream, whisking until the sauce thickens.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the cream sauce over the potatoes and onions.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
